target.reason: A personal-account public repository cannot use organization teams as a branch-protection bypass list; classic branch protection with administrators included is the measured compatible mechanism.

deferred.name: contract
deferred.reason: Path filtering means the check does not exist on a live-only pull request.

deferred.name: Verificar escopo do deploy
deferred.reason: Path filtering means the check does not exist on a documentation-only pull request.

checks.policy: No current check may become required until a disposable-branch trial proves it is emitted for both documentation-only and live-file pull requests on their latest head SHA.

bypass.residualRisk: The personal-account owner has administrative power to edit or remove repository rules; Via A cannot protect against a malicious or compromised owner account.

successEvidence: check names and app source on latest head SHA
blocked and allowed operations with timestamps
review invalidation after a new commit
antiLockout.actionsOutagePolicy: Do not bypass automatically. Freeze merges; the human owner may invoke break-glass only for a documented critical incident.
antiLockout.restorationOwner: Rafael or explicitly delegated human repository owner

rollback.trigger: lockout, unexpected missing check, incompatible merge behavior, or false-positive enforcement
steps: Human owner records the incident, exact rule snapshot, head/base and reason.
Human owner restores the last exported protection payload or disables only the blocking field.
Re-run documentation-only and live-file trial PRs before restoring enforcement.
